layer_differences_not_conflicts.why_not_conflict: OS2 is a simplified fast layer (proxy H, halved asymmetry penalty). OS3 is the full graph equilibrium engine (real hexagons, full asymmetry penalty). Different architectural roles. Both are intra-layer EXACT_MATCH with their respective proof counterparts (P01, P02).
Same value, documented for cross-layer traceability only.
Same value, documented for cross-layer traceability only.
OS3 uses hexagon radial variance penalty (lam). OS2 has no hexagon computation.
OS2 embeds theta_S=0.25 in decision_act_hold(). OS3 exposes S directly, theta_S is passed at call site.
OS3 separates triangle threshold (theta_T), radial threshold (theta_R), arc threshold (theta_A). OS2 uses a single unified theta.
Radial hexagon threshold — OS3 only concept.
Arc hexagon threshold — OS3 only concept.
